title: NotiVas v1.5.0
notes:
• Dual-Theme Architecture: Introduced canonical MIUIX dual-theme architecture with decoupled scaffolds, animated searchbars, and edge-to-edge copilot aura.
• Academic Performance Views: Added separate academic performance views tailored for MIUIX and Material 3 Expressive, featuring real course averages and interactive widgets.
• Interactive Resource Cards: Added interactive resource cards in the assistant with live thinking status, quick suggestions, and Google Search grounding tools.
• Assistant Redesign: Redesigned assistant responses to an unbubbled style featuring waiting dots and live activity status.
• Enhanced Features and Alerts: Added custom reminders with MIUIX snackbars, foros week grouping, new content alerts, and liquid glass topbar actions capsules with native pull-to-refresh.
